scope: Save/load lot 7: original Save/Load bodies of the world logic (Trigger, BigTrigger, ToggleTrigger, ExitTrigger, ObjectivesTrigger, ConversationTrigger, CinematicTrigger, Spawner, KeyFramer with KeyData, CameraObj), their PRECREATE_SAVEGAME and INITIALUPDATE_SAVEGAME branches and save-support declarations, and the self-triggered Door's restored Trigger. The bodies are selective ports recorded in the provenance ledger; the checks, KeyFramer's target rebuild, the camera republication and the Spawner departure are OpenBlood2 code.

references.purpose: Trigger Save/Load field order (Trigger.cpp:1046-1141), the relative delay start, the WORLDFILE/STRINGPROP-only ReadProp and skipped savegame InitialUpdate (:595-645); BigTrigger without a handler; ToggleTrigger's block before Trigger's (:1244-1337).
MAX_TRIGGER_MESSAGES and the unsaved m_hLastSender/m_bSending members.
ExitTrigger block (ExitTrigger.cpp:213-240) and the ENDWORLD exit types set by ReadProp.
ObjectivesTrigger block (ObjectivesTrigger.cpp:220-247) and the unsaved m_hstrSound.
ConversationTrigger block (ConversationTrigger.cpp:315-356), CT_MAXMESSAGES and the byte count and cursor.
CinematicTrigger block (CinematicTrigger.cpp:463-505), the savegame-skipped initial update and the unsaved m_hCurSound whose absence restarts the current cue (Update :209-253, StartSound :373-418).
Spawner block (Spawner.cpp:429-476), the WORLDFILE-only ReadProp and the unconditional initial update (:97-110) that stops a running spawner after a restore (decision-4 departure).

KeyFramer block (KeyFramer.cpp:714-845): byte key count, float-encoded current/position indices, the per-key offset loop; BuildObjectList rebuilding the unsaved object list with new links (:274-298); GoActive, ProcessKey's position-key pairing and the unsaved key sound.
m_pOffsets/m_pRotations as CDynArray members indexed by controlled object.
KeyData block (KeyData.cpp:121-165) and Copy's key types (target and message only as a pair).
POSITION_KEY, SOUND_KEY, MESSAGE_KEY and BPRINT_KEY values.
CDynArray::operator[] growing with uninitialized storage: a KeyFramer target past the saved key count reads an undefined offset in the original.

CameraObj block (CameraObj.cpp:610-658), PostPropRead on every precreate (:205-232), the camera-list insertion for a savegame, the engine-saved SFX_CAMERA_ID message and the SetActive Load tail restarting a timed camera.
The self-spawned trigger saved as a LoadSave reference and linked to its door (SpawnTrigger).
Audit sections 1-3, 7, 20 and 27 used as the field-order and quirk inventory.
